reason: Storage senders on a supervisor Core: the API worker now authenticates POST /api/v1/storage/events, /inventory and /test with the source token (transport rule on the real client), answers /test itself, and saves reports for the source's project under a storage-source principal bound to the token digest, with a body-digest idempotency key. runtime_delivery accepts that principal only for the report routes, counts a storage event as chat-starting work, and revalidates the source before replay; authentication refuses the principal on operator routes; the storage router accepts it on replay; project workers leave other projects' dispatches pending. test_api_worker.py covers the ingress (token, operator token, guesses, remote HTTP, /test, idempotent retry, routing to the source's project, chat_start, no secret in the durable intent, replay principal and operator bearer, revocation before replay) next to the existing API worker contracts. test_storage_integrations.py covers the worker-side replay (ingest and dispatch into the chat queue, refusal on an operator route, rotated token) and dispatch ownership, plus the single-process sender suite. test_runtime_principal, test_runtime_delivery, test_work_batch_contracts, test_runtime_work_batches, test_runtime_global_reads and test_runtime_global_api cover the principal, delivery, batch and global read paths these changes touch.
exclusions: No UI or native code changed. test_product_knowledge.py is excluded because two of its search tests (headless core, Butler browser mission) fail identically on origin/main; the bundled index was built and verified locally with the edited docs/storage-integrations.md (427 passages), and CI builds and verifies it anyway. Playwright area storage-integrations is excluded: its real-Core fixture cannot complete provider turns on this host's saturated pressure gate and real-core.spec.ts is not run on main; the supervisor journey was checked instead on a scratch Postgres supervisor Core (sender report 202 accepted and dispatched into its incident chat, which drained; /test 200; inventory 202; operator token and revoked source 401; sources list 200). PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL; the new ingress test also passed on PostgreSQL locally.
